spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (घटते)
To act, to strive or endeavour.
r. 10th cl. (घाटयति)
1 To unite or to put together.
2 To injure or kill.
3 To shine.
(इ) घटि, r. 10th cl. (घण्टयति)
To shine.

m. (-टः)
1 A large earthen water jar.
2 The sign

Aquarius.
3

A measure: see कुम्भ.
4 An elephant's frontal sinus.
5 Suspending the breath as a religious exercise.
6 A man who makes effort or exertion.
f. (-टा)
1 A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes.
2 Effort, endeavour.
3 An assembly.
4 A number, a collection, an assemblage.
f. (-टी)
1 The Gharī or Indian clock, a plate of iron or mixed metal on which the hours are struck.
2 A small water jar, a ewer.
E.
घट to endeavour, &c. affixes अच् or अङ्, and fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (घट्टते घट्टयति)
To move.
With परि prefixed,
To spread or diffuse.
With वि,
To rub gently, to scratch.

m. (-ट्टः)
A Ghat, a quay or landing place, steps on the side of a river, &c. leading to the water's edge.
f. (-ट्टी)
A small or inferior landing place, private stairs, &c.
E.
घट्ट to go, affix अच्, and with ङीष् affix, implying diminution.

mf. (-टः-टी)
The nape or back of the neck.
E.
घट to unite, affix अच्; the radical is of the 10th class of roots, whence the penultimate is long.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers.
2 A match-maker, an agent who ascertains or invents genealogies, and negociates matrimonial alliances.
3 A genealogist.
E.
घट to endeavour, and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Who or what takes a water pot.
E.
घट, and ग्रह to take, अच् aff.

f. (-सी)
A bawd or procuress.
E.
घट effort, and दासी a slave or servant.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Effort, exertion.
2 Assembling, bringing together.
3 Joining, mixing.
4 Occurring.
E.
घट to strive, &c. affix युच्.

f. (-ना)
1 Going, moving.
2 Practice, business, means of living.
3 Rubbing or striking together.
E.
घट्ट to go, affix युच्, fem. टाप्.

m. (-निः)
The saint AGASTYA. घट a water jar, and योनि place of birth; the saint being born from a water jar: see कुम्भसम्भव.

m. (-जः)
A large water jar of baked clay.
E.
घट a jar, and राज king, chief.

n. (-नं)
Placing a water pot as a type of DURGĀ, an essential part of various Tāntrika ceremonies.
E.
घट, and स्थापन placing.

m. (-पः)
A covering for a carriage or any article of furniture.
E.
घट, and आटोप pride.

n. (-कं)
The posteriors^1.
f. (-का)
1 The ancle; also घुटिका^2.
2 A Muhūrta or thirtieth part of a day and night.
3 A Daṇḍa or period of twenty-four minutes.
m. (-कः)
A waterman.
E.
घटी a clock, &c. affixes कन् and टाप् for the feminine; otherwise घट a jar, and ठन् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
[2] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 307,308.

f. (-का)
The nape of the neck.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Devised, attempted.
2 Made of.
3 In contact with, contiguous, joined.
E.
घट^1 to make effort, क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306. note: Gawita is 'kta' of root Gawa.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Who blows or sounds in a jar.
m. (-मः)
A potter.
E.
घटी, and ध्मा to blow, खश् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Who drinks a Ghaṭī, (in measure.)
E.
घटी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.

m. (-रः)
A potter.
E.
घट, कार who makes, with च्चि aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Who or what takes a small jar, &c.
E.
घटी, and ग्रह who takes.

n. (-न्त्रं)
The rope and bucket of a well, or any machine for raising water.
E.
घट effort, and यन्त्र machine.

m. (-चः)
The son of BHĪMA by the Rākṣasī, named HIḌIMBĀ.

m. (-कः)
A name of KARṆA, natural brother to the Pāṇḍus.
E.
घटोत्कच a proper name, and अन्तक destroyer.

m. (-वः)
The sage AGASTYA.
E.
घट a jar, and उद्भव born, produced.

m. (-वी)
An attendant at a landing place, who takes care of the clothes of the bathers, &c.
E.
घट्ट, and जीविन् who subsists.
